ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. A broad, low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle into a triangular shape at the fluke center. Black pixel mapping is also concentrated along the entire trailing edge and distal tips, with a transition zone of high-frequency mottling between the white and black fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the full trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 3 and 12 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve toward the tips. The trailing edge follows a generally concave sweep from the tips toward the median notch, heavily modified by local serration geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions are detectable on the high-intensity white field of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of sessile organisms (barnacles) at the lateral tips; highly irregular trailing edge profile indicates historical mechanical wear or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark pigmentation 'bridge' extending from the notch area upward into the fluke, creating a distinct visual bisection of the white ventral region.
